comparison_processing: Same checkpoints/frame numbers as fixed-radius intensity-3 calibration; panels resized and labelled, no color or exposure edits.
limits: Screen-space final-color composition, not separate ambient lighting or global illumination.
Distance scaling is an artistic radius policy and stops at 3x; it does not recover hidden or off-screen geometry.
Post-effects without geometric depth retain their previous appearance; underwater case has no AO.
Eight short checkpoint windows, not whole-game visual certification.
Diagnostic timings vary with GPU conditions and are not a production FPS benchmark or evidence of a speedup.
The 25% reduction applies to the intensity parameter; enlarged radius, clamping and filtering prevent a uniform 25% reduction of image darkening.
This revision runs the expanded GPU contact test, 17 launcher/packaging tests and the eight-scene matrix; earlier full test suite totals are historical.
